operating_income.source: not found: operating income is null in deskstack data for FY2023-FY2025 (verify_value also not_found); not filled from memory

d_and_a.source: Computed: us-gaap:Depreciation (1828/2104/3045) + us-gaap:AmortizationOfIntangibleAssets (2000/2400/2800), accession 0000310158-26-000063; amortization values appear rounded in source

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY23-25 growth was 6.7% and 1.3%; near-term growth from the current portfolio, slowing 2028-29 for expected Keytruda patent expiry (general knowledge, not from a filing) and recovering as newer products launch.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: operating income not reported in data. Proxy FY2025 (pretax income 21,067 + interest expense 1,357)/revenue 65,011 = 34.5%, which includes other income/expense. Haircut to 33% for margin pressure and R&D/acquisition charges.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approximate effective rate for a global pharma with an FY2025 ratio of (21,067-18,254)/21,067 = 13.4% from filed pretax and net income; rounded up for conservatism.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 D&A 5,845/65,011 = 9.0% (computed from filed depreciation and amortization).

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex 4,112/65,011 = 6.3%, with FY2023-25 range 5.3-6.4%.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 1.02 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = 9.4% cost of equity; beta = cash-corrected unlevered 0.915 relevered at D/E 0.145 and 21% tax (Damodaran Drugs industry; company market D/E not available since there is no price). Weights 87.3/12.7 with after-tax cost of debt 4.5% (Damodaran) give about 8.8%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the long-run nominal US GDP growth and below the 10Y Treasury yield of 4.86%; mature pharma.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 49,339 (LT debt noncurrent 46,750 + current debt 2,589) - cash 14,565 - short-term investments 0; accession 0000310158-26-000063
